states.name: main
states.eval: document.querySelectorAll('#dc-root > div > img, #dc-root > div > div[style*="inset: 0"]').forEach(e => e.remove()); const bp = document.querySelectorAll('div[style*="top: 66px"] svg path'); bp[0].setAttribute('fill', '#7a7a7a'); bp[1].setAttribute('fill', '#7a7a7a'); bp[2].setAttribute('fill', '#ffffff'); bp[4].setAttribute('stroke', '#7a7a7a'); document.querySelector('div[style*="inset: 10px"]').style.background = 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 68%)'; document.querySelectorAll('div[style*="top: 140px"] svg animate').forEach(e => e.remove()); document.querySelectorAll('div[style*="top: 140px"] svg path, div[style*="top: 140px"] svg circle').forEach(e => { if (e.getAttribute('stroke')) e.setAttribute('stroke', '#ffffff'); if (e.getAttribute('fill')) e.setAttribute('fill', '#ffffff'); e.setAttribute('opacity', '0.8'); }); document.querySelectorAll('.pop, [style*="animation"]').forEach(e => { e.style.animation = 'none'; });
